rooms.name: Millford Gate
rooms.description: A weathered wooden arch spans the muddy road, marking the northern edge of the village of Millford. Beyond it, cottages with smoking chimneys huddle around a cobbled square. To the north the road fades into open wilderness. A crooked signpost stands beside the arch.

details.arch: The arch is built of dark, weather-stained beams, carved long ago with vines and small birds. Someone has tied a faded ribbon to its highest post.
details.sign: A crooked wooden sign reads: 'MILLFORD. Travelers welcome. The village map is posted below.'
